info.title: goldpath — the Goldpath golden-path CLI (thin and deterministic
info.description: The goldpath golden-path CLI: goldpath new (manifest-aware dotnet new passthrough), goldpath add feature (anchor-driven textual transform, specdrift-verified with rollback), goldpath check (validate + drift + build in one verb). Thin and deterministic by design - no new semantics beyond the templates and the drift profile.
